concepts.way: misconception: i and a[i] are the same thing, so the position is the stored value
concepts.quote: Nothing: i only goes up to 2, so a[5] cannot be reached.
concepts.why: The answer treats a[5] as reachable only if the loop variable i reaches 5, but a[5] always uses the literal index 5, so the loop prints 8 three times.
The answer says nothing about two array variables referring to the same array.
Apart from the loop range of i, the answer makes no statement about variables, and its wrong reasoning is about indexing.
The answer says nothing about swapping array elements.
